The main takeaway from our work is that

a simple algorithm for learning optimal control can be made robust to gradual changes in the environment by focusing the computational resources on a low-dimensional manifold embedded in the high dimensional state space.

by parametrizing a policy only along the manifold of its optimal trajectories, it is possible to learn a policy that is robust to a wide range of changes in the task, without increasing the dimensionality of the search space.
